description: This PHP file defines an administrative controller for managing user API keys within an OpenCart e-commerce system. It provides functionality for listing, creating, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting API entries, and viewing their access histories. The class Api extends the core Controller and interacts with models, views, and handles HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for managing user API keys in the admin panel. Handles CRUD operations, enabling/disabling APIs, listing APIs with pagination, and viewing API call histories.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main API management page, including breadcrumbs and links to add, delete, enable, or disable APIs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON or view output of the list of APIs, primarily calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of API entries, fetches data from the model, and prepares the view for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an API entry, populating fields if editing existing data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (creating or updating) an API entry based on form input, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of API calls for a specific API key.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the paginated log of API call histories for a specific API key.
